name: projectiii-pern-ts-baseline
description: Baseline PERN + TypeScript monorepo scaffold for ERP-style projects

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w backend-node" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend-node && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend-node && npm run test -w tests/e2e
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend-node && npm run lint -w frontend
